productFlow.roleFlow: ordinary developer, advanced developer, team administrator, auditor
productFlow.scenario: navigate a managed agent workspace without mixing task input, session supervision, runtime terminal, evidence, approval, or setup concerns
productFlow.frequency: high for Run, medium for Session/Diff/Terminal, low but critical for Evidence/Approval/Setup
productFlow.ownerSurface: Agent Workspace shell with Run-first center surface and contextual right rail
productFlow.usabilityTask: Review the Run-first workspace shell and confirm advanced surfaces stay separated.
productFlow.partialAcceptanceOrFollowUp: Phase C will implement the production Web Console IA shell.

surfaces.name: Run Workspace
tasks: Confirm Run Workspace is findable for ordinary developer.
Confirm states are represented: ready, running, approval_needed, succeeded_with_changes.
Confirm owner surface remains Run-first Agent Workspace shell.
Confirm Findable: Run is the default active surface.
Confirm Understandable: task, status, and context rail are separated.
Confirm Actionable: run, cancel, approve/deny, review diff, and open session appear only when relevant.
Confirm Traceable: session and evidence summaries are reachable from the context rail.
